The perceptual_quality_auditor's null distortion verdict for the croissant supports its high authenticity.

7. Upward Override Justification: No upward overrides were made. All positive verdicts (atoms 1-3) were independently verified through visual inspection and expert evidence, not merely accepted from the Router.

Final scores remain unchanged from initial assessment as they accurately reflect the image's strengths (excellent croissant rendering, correct object presence) and weaknesses (count error, minor flamingo anatomical artifacts).
